standard.title: OWASP Top 10:2025
standard.description: Pinned risk-awareness categories with independently authored, bounded Contractor source-analysis scenarios. Scenario coverage is not certification or an exhaustive security assessment.

license.attribution: OWASP Foundation, OWASP Top 10:2025. Category identifiers and titles are reproduced; Contractor scenario mappings and statements are independently authored adaptations.

entries.title: Broken Access Control
entries.statement: Application authorization controls may fail to enforce the intended subject, object, tenant, or action boundary.

entries.title: Security Misconfiguration
entries.statement: Application-owned configuration and defaults may expose unsafe services, diagnostics, permissions, or deployment behavior.

entries.title: Software Supply Chain Failures
entries.statement: Dependencies and application-owned build or update paths may accept components without sufficient integrity and provenance controls.

entries.title: Cryptographic Failures
entries.statement: Application-owned cryptographic choices, secret handling, or transport assumptions may fail to protect sensitive data.

entries.title: Injection
entries.statement: Untrusted input may reach an interpreter or structured command boundary without an appropriate encoding, validation, or parameterization control.

entries.title: Insecure Design
entries.statement: Security-relevant trust boundaries and abuse cases may lack an application-owned preventive design control.

entries.title: Authentication Failures
entries.statement: Application authentication, session, and credential lifecycle paths may permit identity confusion or account compromise.

entries.title: Software or Data Integrity Failures
entries.statement: Application trust decisions may consume software, updates, serialized data, or other content without sufficient integrity validation.

entries.title: Security Logging and Alerting Failures
entries.statement: Application-owned security events may be omitted, expose sensitive data, or lack enough context for downstream detection and response.

entries.title: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
entries.statement: Exceptional paths may fail open, leak sensitive detail, corrupt state, or leave security-relevant resources in an unsafe condition.

mappings.title: Trace application access-control enforcement
mappings.objective: Inspect representative application-owned entry points and authorization decisions for missing object, action, role, or tenant enforcement. Assess only the traced paths; record uninspected surfaces as gaps.

mappings.title: Review application security configuration
mappings.objective: Inspect application-owned defaults and deployment configuration for exposed diagnostics, permissive security settings, unsafe headers, or unnecessary services. Treat absent deployment context as a gap.

mappings.title: Review dependency and build trust boundaries
mappings.objective: Inspect available dependency manifests and application-owned build or update logic for unpinned inputs, unsafe sources, and missing integrity controls. Do not infer external registry or CI policy that is absent from the source archive.

mappings.title: Trace sensitive-data cryptographic handling
mappings.objective: Inspect representative application-owned cryptographic, secret-storage, and transport-security paths for obsolete primitives, unsafe modes, embedded secrets, or missing protection. Record unknown infrastructure behavior as gaps.

mappings.title: Trace untrusted input to interpreter boundaries
mappings.objective: Trace representative untrusted inputs to database, shell, template, expression, or parser boundaries and inspect the applicable parameterization, encoding, or validation controls. Preserve unresolved paths as gaps.

mappings.title: Inspect security-relevant design controls
mappings.objective: Inspect source-visible trust boundaries, privileged flows, and abuse-sensitive operations for missing preventive controls. Do not claim that source analysis establishes design completeness; preserve architectural uncertainty as gaps.

mappings.title: Review authentication and session paths
mappings.objective: Inspect representative authentication, credential recovery, session creation, validation, rotation, and invalidation paths for identity or lifecycle weaknesses. Record identity-provider behavior absent from source as gaps.

mappings.title: Review software and data integrity decisions
mappings.objective: Inspect application-owned update, plugin, deserialization, signature, and trusted-data ingestion paths for decisions made without suitable integrity checks. Keep unobserved delivery infrastructure outside the assessed claim.

mappings.title: Review security event instrumentation
mappings.objective: Inspect representative application-owned authentication, authorization, validation, and failure paths for useful security logging without sensitive-data exposure. Treat downstream collection and alert behavior as unverified unless supplied.

mappings.title: Review exceptional security paths
mappings.objective: Inspect representative exception, timeout, retry, rollback, and resource-cleanup paths for fail-open behavior, sensitive disclosure, partial authorization, or unsafe state retention. Preserve untraced exceptional paths as gaps.
